description: Replace exact reduced-leaf eigensolves with tolerance-aware spectral windows. Use concurrent sign/Chebyshev projectors to form orthogonal invariant subspaces whose estimated spectral width already satisfies the dimension-scaled residual contract; within each window use Rayleigh diagonals or cheap local rotations instead of a dense leaf solve. Adaptively refine only wide or gate-failing windows, then apply one FP32 residual/reconstruction gate and fallback.

Replaced all three K~683 exact reduced leaf eigensolves with Rayleigh diagonals of the sign-filtered CQR bases. Validation passed 39/39 through the existing residual fallback. Dense n2048 measured 245170 us and aggregate 27300.942 us: the three windows are too wide and all matrices pay projector work plus cuSOLVER. Nsys confirms 39.94 ms TF32 projector GEMMs followed by cuSOLVER symv/gemv/sytrd.

Added two shifted orthogonal-iteration steps independently inside each of the three sign-defined windows, with one-pass CQR between steps, then used Rayleigh diagonals. Validation 39/39 passed through the safety gate; dense n2048 still fell back but improved from 245170 to 227872 us, aggregate 27237.965 us. Three coarse windows remain too wide for diagonal Rayleigh output.

Replaced the three exact leaves with a shared degree-96 Jackson-Chebyshev recurrence feeding 48 equal-width spectral windows of 64 vectors, stacked shifted CQR, global norm membership selection, full-basis finish, and Rayleigh values. Validation passed 39/39 through fallback. The approximate basis did not clear the n2048 gate; dense n2048 measured 267444 us and aggregate 27525.389 us, quantifying about 82 ms of filter/CQR work before cuSOLVER.

Raised each of 48 equal-width Chebyshev windows from 64 to 96 columns so central semicircle bands can represent all ~80 modes, then combined shifted-CQR numerical rank with hard normalized-Rayleigh ownership to prevent adjacent-window duplicate selection. Validation remained 39/39 through fallback; n2048 still failed the custom gate and rose to 307340 us from the larger filter bank, aggregate 27756.032 us.

Made diagnostics runtime-controlled, shared one 96-column Chebyshev recurrence across all 48 filters, estimated window ranks from filter energy, allocated exactly 2048 columns by largest-remainder rounding, and compacted per-window membership selections. Validation 39/39 passed via fallback. Custom n2048 orth remained 11.5 versus 0.0183 gate and eigr 0.49-0.64 versus 0.0366, so rank allocation still leaves a deficient global basis. Shared recurrence reduced n2048 from 307340 to 252000 us; aggregate 27361.664. Nsys shows the custom overhead is now dominated by 58.6 ms of degree-by-degree full filter accumulation, while 96 recurrence GEMMs cost 14.6 ms.

Replaced the Chebyshev route full-basis shifted-CQR/NS finish with FP32 Householder QR. It repaired orthogonality from 11.5 to 9.3e-5 versus the 0.0183 gate, proving cleanup caused the orth failure, but the orthogonal completion mixed/missed windows and eigen residual remained 0.82-0.87 versus 0.0366. Validation passed via fallback; n2048 332018 us and aggregate 27987.624 us due QR plus cuSOLVER.

Replaced shifted CQR plus energy rank allocation with batched 96x96 Gram eigensolves per Chebyshev window, normalized singular directions, singular-strength ranking, hard Rayleigh ownership, global selection, and FP32 QR. This reduced custom eigr from 0.82-0.87 to 0.69-0.72 on the benchmark while orth stayed 9e-5, but remained above the 0.0366 gate. Validation passed via fallback; n2048 329339 us and aggregate 27967.654 us.

Stored all 97 Chebyshev moments once and evaluated 48 window filters with one tall moment-by-coefficient GEMM, replacing 97 expanded full-Y accumulations. Validation passed via fallback; custom eigr stayed 0.63-0.72 with orth 9e-5, but n2048 improved from 329339 to 306586 us and aggregate from 27967.654 to 27819.192, removing about 23 ms of filter construction overhead.

Raised the Jackson-Chebyshev filter from degree 96 to aligned degree 255. Orthogonality remained 8.7e-5; benchmark custom eigr improved modestly from 0.63-0.72 to 0.53-0.65 but stayed far above 0.0366, while extra recurrence work raised n2048 from 306586 to 322571 us and aggregate to 27920.533. Validation passed via fallback.

Allocated per-window dimensions from unbiased Hutchinson trace(P_i)=Omega^T P_i Omega rather than trace(P_i^2), normalized with largest-remainder rounding to exactly 2048, then selected that many local singular directions. Validation custom eigr improved to 0.37-0.42, but benchmark remained 0.63-0.76 and all matrices fell back. n2048 322812 us, aggregate 27935.500; the fixed probe trace estimate or filter scaling remains unstable across batches.

Sorted selected candidates by Rayleigh location before full QR and added a 96x96 Rayleigh-Ritz eigensolve inside every filtered window, ranking local eigenpairs by owned-window residual before trace-count selection. Validation passed via fallback, but local rotations amplified leakage/completion directions: benchmark eigr 0.83-0.87 and n2048 369082 us; aggregate 28206.342. The exact small rotations do not repair an incorrectly selected global union.

Removed Rayleigh ownership/local Ritz heuristics and kept exactly the trace-estimated number of largest singular directions from each Chebyshev-filtered range, concatenated in strict window order before FP32 QR. Validation passed via fallback, but benchmark eigr stayed 0.87-0.91 and n2048 314388 us, aggregate 27850.062. Top singular ranges plus stochastic counts still do not form the full invariant basis.

Added an exact full-matrix eigvalsh count oracle while retaining Chebyshev-derived eigenvectors, isolating rank estimation from filtered-range quality. Exact counts left custom eigr byte-for-byte at 0.86-0.91 on the benchmark, proving the stochastic trace counts were not the limiting error. Validation passed via fallback; eigvalsh overhead raised n2048 to 496393 us and aggregate 28825.412.

Moved the exact eigvalsh oracle ahead of filtering and scaled the Chebyshev recurrence by the exact max-centered eigenvalue magnitude with 0.1% padding. Custom eigr remained 0.87-0.90, so spectral-bound underestimation was not the filtered-range failure. Validation passed via fallback; n2048 490104 us and aggregate 28809.086.

Merged 48 adjacent Chebyshev bands into 24 wider windows and increased the shared probe from 96 to 128 columns, improving oversampling and filter-gap/window-width ratio. With exact radius and counts, custom eigr remained 0.83-0.84 and all matrices fell back; n2048 498653 us, aggregate 28836.818. Boundary density was not the primary range-extraction failure.

Executed 15 logged tolerance-window trials. Best measured branch point was 58479d91b at 27237.965 us (39/39): three sign-defined windows, two shifted orthogonal iterations, Rayleigh diagonals; n2048 still paid custom plus fallback at 227872 us. The flat Chebyshev line built a real shared-moment filter bank (48x64 then 48x96 and 24x128), degree 96/255 Jackson filters, one common probe, one moment GEMM, local 96x96 Gram/SVD and Rayleigh rotations, stochastic trace and exact count oracles, power and exact spectral bounds, spectral ordering, FP32 Householder QR, and unchanged residual fallback. Exact counts and exact bounds left custom eigr unchanged; FP32 QR fixed orth from ~11.5 to ~1e-4 but eigr remained 0.5-1.5 versus 0.0366. Moment GEMM removed ~23 ms; degree255 narrowed eigr modestly but cost more. Current 24-window tip 7f8c4730b validates 39/39 via fallback, 28836.818 us; final nsys is brief-9-trial-15-7f8c4730b.nsys-rep. Keep this objective moving with an adaptive binary projector tree that refines only boundary/wide windows, rank-revealing pivoted QR that preserves window labels, rational/FEAST filters with true stopbands, or per-window exact local repair selected before global assembly; lower-precision moment storage and fused DCT contraction remain open once a gate-clean basis exists.
